metadata.name: The Fractal In Hexagons (cope and flexi's sphere code remix)
metadata.author: Jian Simanjuntak
metadata.source: Jian Simanjuntak - The Fractal In Hexagons (cope and flexi's sphere code remix).milk

perFrameCode: d = 20; // distance of the sphere, the farther you're away the more you'll see on the horizon
z = 0.4; // distance of the pane where the scene is projected on, wider distance = smaller apex angle of the camera, very small distances = fish eyes view
w1 = n*0.01;    // solid angles to rotate the sphere in its origin

issues.message: References Milkwave volume-noise samplers that are not currently bound by the runtime.
References custom sampler names; imported texture-slot assets are not currently provisioned in the runtime.
